business.description: Sudarshan Colorants India Limited (formerly Heubach Colorants India Limited) manufactures pigments and preparations serving paints, coatings, plastics, corrosion protection, pharmaceuticals, and seed coloration industries. It is part of ONE Sudarshan, a global pigment major with 19 manufacturing sites across 11 countries.

outlook.statement: Targeting FY2027 return to growth supported by new account wins and expanded portfolio via ONE Sudarshan group
Focus on pigments as core business with broader product portfolio, disciplined cost reduction, and improved capacity utilization
Near-term commercial opportunities in recycling-compatible pigments driven by tightening packaging regulations and low-migration food-contact compliant grades
Localization of premium HP Azo range expected to unlock new export opportunities FY2027 onward
Printing inks segment expected to ease as inventory positions normalize through FY2027

India is poised to maintain its global growth leadership, with FY2027 GDP projected to expand between 6.8% and 7.2%. Strong macro fundamentals should continue to support demand for pigments across paints and coatings, plastics, and inks.

Global growth projected to moderate to 3.1% in 2026 before recovering modestly to 3.2% in 2027. Demand for pigments expected to remain supported by resilient end-use industries, although geopolitical uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics may continue to influence supply chains and market sentiment.

As "One Sudarshan", we are actively developing and implementing a unified decarbonization roadmap that will guide our transition towards lower-carbon operations. This marks an important step in embedding climate action more deeply into our growth strategy, investment priorities, and operational decision-making.

Strengthened sustainability focus continued to guide operational improvement initiatives across the organization during FY2025-26, driving progress on key environmental priorities such as energy efficiency, renewable energy adoption, and resource optimization across the Roha, Cuddalore, and Nagda facilities.
The company expects to contribute ₹2.50 Crores to the funded gratuity plans in the next year.
